fields.description: The searchable copy of the employee's name. 🔴 The grid's own column filter compares the STORED value, and for a Link that is the docname (HR-EMP-00054) - so typing a person's NAME matched nothing, even though the grid displays the name. Measured 2026-09-01 on a 615-row manifest: 'Harun' -> 0 rows, 'HR-EMP-00054' -> 7. This Data field holds the name itself, so the filter finally answers the question HR actually asks.

fields.description: Kept out of the grid's columns so the searchable name can take its place - the Link rendered the same name but could not be searched. Still a real Link: open the row to reach the employee record.

fields.label: Finger Log

fields.description: This punch is NOT what the fingerprint device recorded - the Ingress application wrote it (the machine's _c flag = 1). Usually an HR correction made in the Ingress app; occasionally the machine's own enrolment-day adjustment. Either way it is the row somebody may later argue about. Measured 2026-08-17: the flag that moves on an HR edit is _c, NOT the _x column that looks like an override flag.
